informal_statement: Normalized cap area is positive for every valid cap angle.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:148-157, the source contract is `lemma area_pos {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < θ) (hπ : θ < π) : 0 < area θ`.
